ضَعْضَعَةٌ inf. n. of ضَعْضَعَهُ [q. v.]. (TK.) ―
-b2- And [as though inf. n. of ضُعْضِعَ] Lowliness, humility, or submissiveness: (TA, and Ham p. 369:) [as used in the present day, a state of depression; languor; weakness; and poverty:] and hardship, or adversity. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
